verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships official SDKs built as one C++ core with six thin bindings, and an official runanywhere-sdks GitHub repo. First-party docs cover Swift in depth (streaming, chat, tool calling, structured output, STT/TTS/VAD, voice agent, VLM, model downloads), plus Kotlin and React Native/Expo integration guides. The hosted endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so the official OpenAI clients also work against it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs themselves (the community reports concern the rcli CLI, not the SDKs), and documentation evidence for all six bindings beyond Swift, Kotlin and React Native.
